turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on past questions with did?
turns.tutor:
Sure! To ask about the past we use did + the base verb. Example: What did you do last weekend? Then we answer with the past: I went to the beach.

Try this one. Make a question with did: "you / watch / TV / yesterday"
